test_cases.title: Sign up with valid email and password
steps: Enter a valid password that is at least 8 characters and not one of the 100 most commonly used passwords
test_cases.expected_result: Account is created and email verification link is sent

test_cases.title: Receive email verification link
preconditions: User has signed up with a valid email and password
steps: Check the email inbox for the verification link
test_cases.expected_result: Email verification link is received

test_cases.title: Log in with unverified account
preconditions: User has signed up with a valid email and password but has not verified their email
steps: Enter the email address and password to log in
test_cases.expected_result: User can log in but only has read-only access

test_cases.title: Account suspension after 7 days

steps: Wait for 7 days after sign up
test_cases.expected_result: Account is suspended

test_cases.title: Account activation after email verification
preconditions: User has signed up with a valid email and password and has received the verification link
steps: Click the verification link in the email
test_cases.expected_result: Account is activated

test_cases.title: Reject password less than 8 characters
steps: Enter a password that is less than 8 characters
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects the password

test_cases.title: Reject one of the 100 most commonly used passwords
steps: Enter one of the 100 most commonly used passwords
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects the password

test_cases.title: Unverified account has read-only access for 7 days
preconditions: user has signed up with valid email and password
test_cases.expected_result: user is granted read-only access and write operation is denied

test_cases.title: Unverified account is suspended after 7 days
preconditions: user has signed up with valid email and password
7 days have passed since sign up
steps: attempt to log in with unverified account
